english:
Epistle Romans 1:18 "For the wrath of God is revealed" to verse 25 "forever. Amen." Alleluia, Psalm 92 [93] "Sing to the Lord." Gospel Matthew 8:5 "And when Jesus was entered" to verse 13 "in that selfsame hour."

In the Evening
First Psalm 32 [33] "By the mercy", Tone change [Phokh]: "Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous." Gospel Matthew 3:16 "And Jesus, when he was baptized" to Matthew 4:2 "he was afterward an hungred." Messedi [Mesedi]: "Sing", "Enter." Dismissal [Hambartsi] Hymn, Tone 3 [g3]: "Sun of Righteousness" (Aregakn ard). Dismissal Psalm 147 "Praise Jerusalem." Gospel John 1:29 "The next day" to verse 34 "the Son of God."

Wednesday
Morning Hymn [Ah], Tone 3 [g3]: "Sun of Righteousness" (Aregakn ard), with its canon [sarokn]. Alleluia, Psalm "Send forth thy spirit", "Let them be." Tone change [Phokh]: "Thy spirit", "For thy name's sake." Morning Psalm 132 [133] "Like the precious ointment that ran down", Tone change [Phokh]: "Behold, how good." Book of 1 Kings [1 Samuel] 16:12 "And the Lord said to Samuel" to verse 14 "an evil spirit from the Lord." Prophet Zechariah 12:8 "And it shall come to pass" to verse 10 "and of supplications." Epistle Galatians 3:1 "This I say" to verse 7 "heirs of God." Alleluia, Psalm 44 [45] "Therefore God hath anointed", Tone change [Phokh]: "My heart is inditing." Gospel Matthew 1:18 "Now the birth of Jesus Christ" to verse 21 "from their sins."

Midday Liturgy
Introit [Zhamamut]: "God, thee" (Astuats zkez). Paten Hymn [Sharakan], Tone 3 [g3]: "Sun of Righteousness" (Aregakn). Psalm 64 [65] "Save thy servants", Tone change [Phokh]: "Be merciful." Epistle Romans 2:2 "For we are sure" to verse 11 "before God." Alleluia, Psalm 24 [25] "For thy name's sake." Gospel Matthew 8:18 "Now when Jesus saw" to verse 27 "obey him."

In the Evening
First Psalm 44 [45] "Therefore", Tone change [Phokh]: "My heart is inditing." Gospel John 1:29 "The next day" to verse 34 "the Son of God." Messedi [Mesedi]: "Come and see", "Our God." Dismissal [Hambartsi] Hymn, Tone 3 [gk]: "Without beginning" (Zanaskzbnabar). Dismissal Psalm 132 [133] "Like the ointment", Tone change [Phokh]: "Behold, how good." Gospel Matthew 1:18 "Now the birth of Jesus Christ" to verse 21 "from their sins."

Thursday
Morning Hymn [Ah], Tone 3 [gk]: "Without beginning" (Zanaskzbnabar), with its canon [sarokn]. Alleluia: "I opened my mouth", "Look upon me." Tone change [Phokh]: "At thy rebuke", "He sent." Morning Psalm 18 [19] "More to be desired", Tone change [Phokh]: "The heavens declare." Book of Exodus 30:22 "The Lord spoke to Moses" to verse 29 "most holy." Proverbs of Wisdom 9:13 "For what man is he" to Wisdom 10:2 "to rule all things." Acts 19:1 "And it came to pass" to verse 7 "about twelve." Alleluia, Psalm 45 [46] "The streams of the river", Tone change [Phokh]: "God is our refuge." Gospel John 20:19 "Then the same day at evening" to verse 23 "they are retained."

Midday Liturgy
Introit [Zhamamut]: "Today of the fiery." Paten Hymn [Sharakan], Tone 7 [ek]: "Without beginning" (Zanaskzbnabar). Psalm 98 [99] "Exalt ye", Tone change [Phokh]: "The Lord reigneth." Epistle Romans 2:12 "For as many as" to verse 21 "even as it is written." Alleluia, Psalm 6 "Have mercy upon me, O Lord." Gospel Matthew 8:28 "And when he was come" to verse 34 "out of their coasts."

In the Evening
First Psalm 18 [19] "More to be desired", Tone change [Phokh]: "The heavens declare." Gospel Matthew 1:18 "Now the birth of Jesus Christ" to verse 21 "from their sins." Messedi [Mesedi]: "Our God", "On going out." Dismissal [Hambartsi] Hymn, Tone 3 [g3]: "Immortalizing" (Anmaharar). Dismissal Psalm 45 [46] "The streams of the river", Tone change [Phokh]: "Our God." Gospel John 20:19 "Then the same day at evening" to verse 23 "they are retained."

Friday
Morning Hymn [Ah], Tone 4 [dz]: "Immortalizing Cup" (Anmaharar bazhak), with its canon [sarokn]. Alleluia, Psalm 132 [133] "Like the precious ointment that ran down", "As the dew." Tone change [Phokh]: "In a green pasture", "He restored." Morning Psalm 50 [51] "Create in me a clean heart", Tone change [Phokh]: "Have mercy upon me, O God." Book of Numbers 11:24 "And Moses went out" to verse 27 "in the camp." Proverbs of Wisdom 6:11 "For they that have kept" to verse 17 "shall find her." Epistle Romans 8:2 "For the law of the Spirit" to verse 6 "peace." Alleluia, Psalm 142 [143] "Thy spirit", Tone change [Phokh]: "Lord, hear my prayer." Gospel John 3:1 "There was a man" to verse 8 "that is born of the Spirit."

Midday Liturgy
Introit [Zhamamut]: "For which reason also we." Paten Hymn [Sharakan], Tone 4 [dz]: "Immortalizing" (Anmaharar). Psalm 97 [98] "All the ends have seen", Tone change [Phokh]: "Sing unto the Lord." Epistle Romans 2:25 "For circumcision verily profiteth" to Romans 3:9 "under sin."
